meta.name: House of the Dragon
meta.description:
The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 21 Aug 2022 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: HBO, Bastard Sword, 1:26 Pictures · Network: HBO

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 8/8 | S3 8/8

videos.title: The Heirs of the Dragon
videos.overview: Viserys hosts a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child. Rhaenyra welcomes her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep.

videos.title: The Rogue Prince
videos.overview: Princess Rhaenyra dives deep into the prophecies about House Targaryen while confronting a realm that resists the idea of a woman on the Iron Throne, and Prince Daemon, embittered over being passed over as the heir to Westeros, prepares to go to war.

videos.title: Second of His Name
videos.overview: Daemon and the Sea Snake battle the Crabfeeder. The realm celebrates Aegon's second nameday. Rhaenyra faces the prospect of marriage.

videos.title: King of the Narrow Sea
videos.overview: Daemon returns to court after the successful completion of the battle. Princess Rhaenyra must deal with potential suitors in order to keep her line of succession.

videos.title: We Light the Way
videos.overview: Daemon visits his wife in the Vale. Viserys and Rhaenyra broker agreements with the Valeryons. Alicent seeks the truth about the princess.

videos.title: The Princess and the Queen
videos.overview: Ten years later. Rhaenyra navigates Alicent's continued speculation about her children, while Daemon and Laena weigh an offer in Pentos.

videos.title: Driftmark
videos.overview: As the families gather on Driftmark for a funeral, Viserys calls for an end to infighting and Alicent demands justice.

videos.title: The Lord of the Tides
videos.overview: Six years later. With the Driftmark succession suddenly critical, Rhaenyra attempts to strike a bargain with Rhaenys.

videos.title: The Green Council
videos.overview: While Alicent enlists Cole and Aemond to track down Aegon, Otto gathers the great houses of Westeros to affirm their allegiance.

videos.title: The Black Queen
videos.overview: Mourning a tragic death, Rhaenyra tries to hold the kingdom together and Daemon prepares for war.

videos.title: A Son for a Son
videos.overview: While Rhaenyra struggles to come to terms with her son's murder, in King's Landing, Alicent grows concerned that Aegon's Small Council may lead them to an all-out war. Larys suggests Aegon needs a new Hand, and Rhaenyra arrives at a fateful decision.

videos.title: Rhaenyra the Cruel
videos.overview: As Otto schemes to turn the public against her, Rhaenyra questions Daemon's loyalty. Meanwhile, Ser Criston Cole concocts a misguided plan for revenge.

videos.title: The Burning Mill
videos.overview: As ancient grudges resurface, Rhaenys suggests that Alicent may see reason while the men around her seek bloodshed. Ser Criston proposes a bold scheme. Daemon arrives at Harrenhal to raise an army for the Blacks.

videos.title: The Red Dragon and the Gold
videos.overview: In Rhaenyra's absence and with no word from Daemon at Harrenhal, Rhaenys tries to keep the peace on the Black Council as Cole mounts a campaign into the Crownlands. In King's Landing, Aemond continues to undermine Aegon's fragile hold on authority.

videos.title: Regent
videos.overview: Amid whispers of bad omens, the Greens consider how to fill a void on Aegon's Council, Jacaerys sets out on a rogue mission to strike a deal, and Daemon enlists Lord Willem Blackwood to help persuade the Brackens to bend the knee.

videos.title: Smallfolk
videos.overview: With few options left, Rhaenyra summons a trusted knight for a risky venture and plots with Mysaria to catalyze the smallfolk. Meanwhile, Daemon's unease grows, and Aemond takes steps to reshape the Green Council.

videos.title: The Red Sowing
videos.overview: As Rhaenyra looks to gain an advantage by unusual means, Daemon pressures a young liege lord to raise up his bannermen.

videos.title: The Queen Who Ever Was
videos.overview: As Aemond becomes more volatile, Larys plots an escape, and Alicent grows more concerned about Helaena's safety. Flush with new power, Rhaenyra looks to press her advantage.

videos.title: Salt and Sea, Fire and Blood
videos.overview: Driven by her faith in Alicent, Rhaenyra positions herself to take King's Landing while the Triarchy sails to take on Corlys in the Gullet.

videos.title: Queen's Landing
videos.overview: As Alicent risks everything to fulfill her end of the bargain, Rhaenyra must decide whether the Iron Throne is worth the cost.

videos.title: Rhaenyra Triumphant
videos.overview: Rhaenyra learns the situation in King's Landing is not what she anticipated. Unable to locate her enemies, and with demands coming from all sides, Rhaenyra must navigate a delicate balance between appeasing her supporters and consolidating her rule.

videos.title: Tumbleton
videos.overview: Ormund's invasion of Tumbleton forces Rhaenyra into a corner.

videos.title: Unbowed and Unbent
videos.overview: As the search for Aemond and Vhagar continues, Daemon attempts to control the spiraling situation in King's Landing.

videos.title: Faceless Men
videos.overview: While Rhaenyra and Daemon focus on how best to deal with Ormund, tensions among their neglected allies begin to erupt.

videos.title: The Dragon in Winter
videos.overview: Torn between Mysaria and Daemon's visions for her reign, Rhaenyra grows desperate for a sign that she will prevail.

videos.title: The Treasons at Tumbleton
videos.overview: Shifting alliances irrevocably reshape the war as Rhaenyra's forces converge around Tumbleton and both sides vie to gain the upper hand.
